name: TRIBE Living Bangkok Sukhumvit 39
short_description: A design-led TRIBE Living hotel 10 minutes' walk from EmQuartier/Emporium and Phromphong BTS, with a 4.5/5 ALL Rating (932 reviews) and a rooftop bar.
ai_summary: TRIBE Living Bangkok Sukhumvit 39 is a design-led lifestyle hotel within 10 minutes' walk of the EmQuartier and Emporium shopping malls and Phromphong BTS Skytrain station. The property holds a 4.5/5 ALL Rating from 932 reviews. Facilities include an on-site cafe with barista coffee, a rooftop bar with signature cocktails, and stylish common spaces designed for living, working, and socialising. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.

core_facts.address: 122 Soi Sukhumvit 39, Klongton Nuea, Wattana, 10110 Bangkok, Thailand
elite_benefits: Welcome drink for ALL Silver members and above, per programme terms
